abort.single_instance_allowed: HA Terminal is already set up.

data_description.allow_port_forwarding: Allow ssh -L / -R tunnels through Home Assistant to other devices on your network. Off by default — only turn it on if you use tunnels.
data_description.allow_sftp: File transfer over SSH (sftp / FileZilla), confined to /config.
data_description.shell: Shell to run in the terminal, e.g. /bin/sh or /bin/bash.
data_description.ssh_enabled: Start an SSH server inside the Home Assistant container.
data_description.ssh_port: Port the SSH server listens on (the add-on uses 22; 2222 avoids clashing with it).

user.description: A terminal and file manager that runs inside Home Assistant — no add-on container. The web terminal opens from the sidebar; SSH listens on the port below (admin users only, Home Assistant password or a key in /config/.ssh/authorized_keys).
user.title: HA Terminal
